fields.summary_ko.0: Spot gold fell 3% on Thursday to US$3,852, marking a 1-year low, as strong dollar, expectations of interest rate hikes, and deteriorating US-Iran relations driving higher crude oil prices combine.
fields.summary_ko.1: The market prices the probability of a December Federal Reserve rate hike at approximately 100%, with the possibility of a 50bp increase revised upward to 15%, intensifying pressure on gold's real yield.
